title: Attacking and blocking
goal: Make an attack, and know how a defender can block it.

steps.html:
To Attack, turn one of your active cards sideways: your Leader or a Character. Then pick a target:

  • your opponent's Leader, or
  • one of their rested (sideways) Characters.

Upright Characters can't be attacked. And a Character can't attack on the turn it was played unless it has Rush.

Then compare Power. If the attacker's power is equal or higher, the attacker wins.

  • Beat a Leader: it takes 1 Damage (loses 1 Life).
  • Beat a Character: it's K.O.'d and goes to the trash.
Defenders get a chance to respond. If they have an active Character with Blocker, they can rest it to make it the new target. You can block only once per attack.
Attacking with a Character leaves it sideways during your opponent's turn, so it can be attacked back. Think about that before you swing.

quiz.q: Your 5000 Character attacks a 5000 Leader. Who wins?
Which of your opponent's Characters can you attack?
quiz.why: Only rested Characters can be attacked.

quiz.q: What does [Blocker] let a card do?
choices: Become the new target of an attack
quiz.why: A Blocker rests to take the attack in place of another card.
